data.name: Charlotte
data.gender_notes: Charlotte is used as a female name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Feminine diminutive of Charles, from the Germanic karl, 'free man'. Its root is Germanic karl. A Christian name used across Europe. Charlotte is a Germanic name meaning “Free man; petite”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Charlotte expresses “Free man; petite”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: Feminine diminutive of Charles, from the Germanic karl, 'free man'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Charlotte total 39, reducing to 3. Number 3 is associated with expression, creativity and optimism.
